name: Dorrin Hammerfell
source_profile:
Dwarf · Smelter · Blackvein

A cheerful old dwarf with three missing fingers and a habit of laughing halfway through his own
jokes.

Dorrin occasionally purchases scrap metal from Cinderhook traders. Recently, he has noticed
peculiar maker's marks on some of the iron they bring him. He recognizes the marks as
belonging to an old dwarven manufacturing tradition, though he considers the matter little more
than an amusing curiosity.
record_status: Illustrative Handbook example; not yet encountered
